blocks.text: Buyruq gap: Come here! Sit down!

O'zbek tilida buyruq fe'lning maxsus shakli bilan aytiladi: «Kel!», «Keling!», «Kelinglar!». Ingliz tilida buyruq gap (imperative) ancha oddiy: fe'lning **lug'at shakli** olinadi, ega (you) aytilmaydi: **Come** here! **Sit** down! **Open** the window. Shakl bitta — «sen», «siz», «sizlar» uchun ham bir xil. Hurmat va muloyimlik qo'shimcha bilan emas, **please** so'zi va ohang bilan beriladi: **Please sit down.** / **Sit down, please.**

Buyruq gap faqat buyruq emas. U ko'rsatmalar (retsept, yo'l ko'rsatish: **Turn** left), taklif va mehmondo'stlik (**Have** some tea. **Come** in.), maslahat va ogohlantirish (**Take** a jacket. **Be** careful!), tilaklar (**Have** a nice day! **Enjoy** your meal!) uchun ham ishlatiladi. Notanish odamga buyruq gap qo'pol eshitilmasligi uchun **please** qo'shing yoki **Could you ...?** (→ 30-dars) deb so'rang.

Inkor buyruq — **Don't** + fe'l: **Don't** worry! — «Xavotir olmang!». Inglizchada «Not go!» yoki «No touch!» deyilmaydi — doim **don't**. Yozma e'lon va ko'rsatmalarda to'liq shakl **Do not** uchraydi: **Do not** enter. Fe'l yo'q gaplarda (sifat bilan) **be** kerak: **Be** quiet! — «Jim bo'ling!», **Don't be** late! — «Kechikmang!». O'zbekchada «bo'l» ham shunday ishlaydi: «ehtiyot **bo'l**», «xafa **bo'lma**».

**Let's** (= let us) — so'zlovchi o'zini ham qo'shib taklif qiladi: **Let's** go! — «Ketdik!», «Boraylik!». Bu o'zbekchadagi `-aylik` / `-ylik` qo'shimchasiga to'liq mos: **Let's** eat — «Ovqatlanaylik», **Let's** wait — «Kutaylik». Inkori — **Let's not** + fe'l: **Let's not** wait — «Kutmaylik». Taklifga javob: **Yes, let's.** / **OK.** / **Good idea.** Xuddi shu ma'noda savol shaklida **Shall we** ...? ham ishlatiladi (→ 28-dars): **Shall we** go? — «Ketamizmi?»

items.text: **Let's not** eat out tonight — I'll cook.
items.translation: Bugun kechqurun tashqarida **ovqatlanmaylik** — o'zim ovqat qilaman.

blocks.text: **Let me** ... — «...ay» (o'zim qilay, menga ruxsat bering): **Let me** help you — «Yordamlashib yuboray». Bu **Let's** emas: **Let's** — biz birga qilamiz, **Let me** — men qilaman.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Not touch!» / «No touch!» → **Don't touch!**; «Don't to go.» → **Don't go.**; «Don't late!» → **Don't be late!** (sifat oldida be); «Let's to go!» / «Let's going!» → **Let's go!**; «Let's don't go.» → **Let's not go.**; «You sit down!» — inglizchada buyruqda ega odatda aytilmaydi: **Sit down, please.**

Eslab qolish: buyruq — fe'lning o'zi (**Go!**), inkori — **Don't go!**, birgalikda — **Let's go!**, birgalikda inkor — **Let's not go!**. O'zbekcha `-aylik` ni eshitsangiz, inglizchada **Let's** ni ishlating.

items: Buyruq — fe'lning lug'at shakli, egasiz: **Wait** here. **Have** some cake.
Sifat bilan — **Be** ...! / **Don't be** ...!: **Be** careful! **Don't be** shy!
Muloyimlik — **please** va ohang bilan: **Please** come in.
Birgalikka taklif — **Let's** + fe'l («...aylik»), inkori — **Let's not** + fe'l («...maylik»).

examples.title: Instructions and directions: **Turn** left!
examples.description: Yo'l ko'rsatish, retsept va ko'rsatmalar — buyruq gap: fe'lning lug'at shakli, egasiz. O'zbekchada odatda «-ing» shakli.

sentences.text: **Turn** left at the traffic lights and **go** straight on.
**Take** the number 5 bus and **get off** at the museum.
First **wash** the rice, then **put** it in the pot.
**Press** the green button to start the machine.
sentences.translation: Mashinani ishga tushirish uchun yashil tugmani **bosing**.

sentences.text: **Write** your name and address at the top of the form.
To get to the station, **cross** the bridge and **ask** someone there.
sentences.translation: Vokzalga borish uchun ko'prikdan **o'ting** va u yerda kimdandir **so'rang**.

sentences.text: **Open** your books at page twenty and **read** the first text.
sentences.translation: Kitoblaringizni yigirmanchi betdan **oching** va birinchi matnni **o'qing**.

sentences.text: **Add** a little salt and **cook** it for another ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Ozgina tuz **qo'shing** va yana o'n daqiqa **pishiring**.

sentences.text: When you arrive in Tashkent, **call** me from the airport.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga yetib kelganingizda aeroportdan menga **qo'ng'iroq qiling**.

sentences.text: Aziz, **switch off** the lights and **lock** the door when you leave.

examples.title: Invitations and wishes: **Come in**, **have** some tea
examples.description: Buyruq gap mehmondo'stlik, taklif va tilaklarda ham ishlatiladi: **Come in**, **Have** some tea, **Enjoy** your meal. Muloyimlik — **please** va ohang bilan.

sentences.text: **Come in** and **sit down**, please.
**Have** some more tea — it's still hot.
Please **help yourself** to the salad.
**Make yourself at home**, Emma.
Dilnoza, **come** and **look** at these photos!
Please **take** a seat. The doctor will see you in a few minutes.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **o'tiring**. Shifokor sizni bir necha daqiqadan keyin qabul qiladi.

sentences.text: Here's your plov. **Enjoy** your meal!
**Have** a good trip to Bukhara, and **send** us some photos!
Next time you're in Oxford, **stay** with us.
**Give** my regards to your parents.

examples.title: Warnings and advice: **Don't** ...!
examples.description: Inkor buyruq — **Don't** + fe'l («...ma!», «...mang!»). Yozma e'lonlarda — **Do not**. «Not go!», «No touch!» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: **Don't** worry — everything is fine.
Please **don't** touch the paintings.
Children, **don't** play with matches!
**Don't** forget your passport, Aziz!
Careful! **Don't** drop that box. It's full of glasses.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'l! U qutini **tushirib yuborma**. U stakanlarga to'la.

sentences.text: Sorry, **don't** sit there — the paint is still wet.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, u yerga **o'tirmang** — bo'yoq hali qurimagan.

sentences.text: Madina, **don't** eat so many sweets before dinner.
sentences.translation: Madina, kechki ovqatdan oldin bunchalik ko'p shirinlik **yema**.

sentences.text: You look very tired. **Don't** drive tonight — take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Juda charchagan ko'rinasiz. Bugun **mashina haydamang** — taksiga o'tiring.

sentences.text: **Do not** use the lift in case of fire.
And **don't** tell anyone about our plan, OK?
sentences.translation: Va rejamiz haqida hech kimga **aytma**, xo'pmi?

examples.title: **Be** careful! **Don't be** late!
examples.description: Sifat yoki holat bilan buyruqda **be** kerak: **Be** quiet! — «Jim bo'ling!», **Don't be** late! — «Kechikmang!». O'zbekchadagi «bo'l / bo'lma» ga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: **Be** careful — the floor is wet.
Children, **be** quiet, please! The baby is asleep.
**Don't be** late for the meeting tomorrow.
**Be** nice to your little brother, Bekzod.
Please **don't be** angry with me — it was an accident.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, mendan **xafa bo'lmang** — bu tasodifan bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Be** ready at seven — the taxi is coming at quarter past.
sentences.translation: Soat yettida **tayyor bo'l** — taksi yettidan o'n besh daqiqa o'tganda keladi.

sentences.text: Come on, **don't be** shy! Tell us about your trip.
On your first day at a new job, **be** polite and **ask** a lot of questions.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishdagi birinchi kuningizda **xushmuomala bo'ling** va ko'p savol **bering**.

sentences.text: Sarah, **don't be** silly — of course we can help you.
sentences.translation: Sara, **bema'ni gapirma** — albatta, senga yordam bera olamiz.

sentences.text: Mr Brown, please **be** patient with the new students — they're still learning.
sentences.translation: Janob Braun, iltimos, yangi talabalarga **sabrli bo'ling** — ular hali o'rganishyapti.

examples.title: Suggestions: **Let's** ...
examples.description: **Let's** + fe'l = «...aylik»: so'zlovchi o'zini ham qo'shib taklif qiladi. Ko'pincha oldin vaziyat aytiladi: «Qornim och. Tushlik qilaylik».

sentences.text: It's a lovely day. **Let's** go to the park.
I'm hungry. **Let's** have lunch.
**Let's** take a taxi — it's raining.
Come on, everyone, **let's** start the lesson.
The film starts at eight, so **let's** meet at half past seven.
sentences.translation: Film soat sakkizda boshlanadi, shuning uchun yetti yarimda **uchrashaylik**.

sentences.text: Tom, **let's** play chess tonight!
We've got a free weekend. **Let's** visit Grandma in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari bo'shmiz. Samarqandga buvimnikiga **boraylik**.

sentences.text: **Let's** ask Madina — she knows the city very well.
sentences.translation: Madinadan **so'raylik** — u shaharni juda yaxshi biladi.

sentences.text: It's Mum's birthday on Sunday. **Let's** buy her some flowers.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni oyimning tug'ilgan kuni. Unga gul **olaylik**.

sentences.text: Shall we walk or take the bus? — **Let's** walk; it's only ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Piyoda boramizmi yoki avtobusdami? — Piyoda **boraylik**, bor-yo'g'i o'n daqiqa.

examples.title: **Let's not** ...: let's do something else
examples.description: Inkor taklif — **Let's not** + fe'l = «...maylik». Ko'pincha o'rniga boshqa taklif keladi: **Let's not** wait — **let's** go.

sentences.text: **Let's not** take the car. **Let's** walk instead.
It's very late. **Let's not** watch another film.
**Let's not** talk about work tonight.
Please, **let's not** argue in front of the children.
That restaurant is very expensive. **Let's not** go there.
sentences.translation: U restoran juda qimmat. U yerga **bormaylik**.

sentences.text: We've got an early flight, so **let's not** stay up late.
sentences.translation: Erta tongda parvozimiz bor, shuning uchun kechgacha **o'tirmaylik**.

sentences.text: Shh! **Let's not** tell Aziz about the party — it's a surprise.
sentences.translation: Jim! Azizga bazm haqida **aytmaylik** — bu kutilmagan sovg'a.

sentences.text: OK, **let's not** decide now. **Let's** think about it tomorrow.
The weather is terrible, so **let's not** go to the mountains this weekend.
sentences.translation: Havo juda yomon, shuning uchun bu dam olish kunlari tog'ga **bormaylik**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza, **let's not** wait for the bus — **let's** take a taxi.

examples.title: Do this, **don't** do that!
examples.description: Tasdiq va inkor buyruq yonma-yon: nima qilish va nima qilmaslik kerak. Ikki qismli gaplar: ... **and don't** ..., **don't** ... — ...

sentences.text: **Close** the window, but **don't** lock it.
**Call** me tonight, but **don't** call after ten.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun menga **qo'ng'iroq qil**, lekin soat o'ndan keyin **qo'ng'iroq qilma**.

sentences.text: **Eat** more vegetables and **don't** drink so much cola.
sentences.translation: Ko'proq sabzavot **ye** va bunchalik ko'p kola **ichma**.

sentences.text: **Don't** use a pen in the exam — **use** a pencil.
**Take** your umbrella, and **don't** leave it on the bus this time!
**Speak** slowly and **don't** worry about small mistakes.
sentences.translation: Sekin **gapiring** va kichik xatolar haqida **xavotir olmang**.

sentences.text: James, **don't** buy a new phone — **fix** the old one.
**Wear** comfortable shoes, and **don't** carry heavy bags — we're walking all day.
sentences.translation: Qulay poyabzal **kiying**, og'ir sumka **ko'tarmang** — kun bo'yi piyoda yuramiz.

sentences.text: **Don't** stand there — **come** and help me!
In the exam, **read** the questions carefully and **don't** hurry.

examples.title: Dialogue: a day out in London
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st kunni rejalashtiradi — **Let's**, **Let's not**, buyruq gap, **Don't**, **Be** ... va **Let me**.

sentences.text: — Look, the sun is shining! **Let's** go out for the day.
sentences.translation: — Qara, quyosh charaqlayapti! Kun bo'yi sayrga **chiqaylik**.

sentences.text: — Good idea. **Let's** take the boat to Greenwich.
— OK, but **don't** forget your camera this time.
— It's already in my bag. **Let's not** take the car, though.
— Fine. **Wear** your trainers; we're going to walk a lot.
— **Be** quick, then! The next boat leaves at ten.
sentences.translation: — Unda **tezroq bo'l**! Keyingi kema soat o'nda jo'naydi.

sentences.text: — **Wait** a minute — **let me** find my sunglasses.
— Hurry up! And **don't** take a big bag — **bring** just your wallet and phone.
sentences.translation: — Tezroq! Katta sumka **olma** — faqat hamyon va telefoningni **ol**.

sentences.text: — Ready! **Let's** have lunch in a café by the river.
— Perfect. **Lock** the door and **let's** go!
